instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's current admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
3. Scroll down to the "Return Request Form" section
4. Click on the "Edit" button next to "Return Reason"
5. In the "Return Reason" field, click on the "Add a new field" dropdown menu and select "Text Field"
7. Set the label for this field to something like "Reason for Return"
9. Now, you need to add a script tag to your theme's liquid files to render the returns reason capture form
10. In your Shopify admin panel, go to "Online Store" > "Themes"
11. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu and select "Edit code"
12. Open the `theme.liquid` file and add the following script tag before the closing `</body>` tag:
13. Replace `https://example.com/returns-reason-form.js` with the actual URL of your returns reason capture form script
14. Save your changes and preview your store to test the returns reason capture form
